security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-eval' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:

bundle.shortDescription: Excel-like table UI for creating Mermaid diagrams
bundle.longDescription: Workflow Visualizer is a desktop application that lets you create professional Mermaid diagrams using an intuitive Excel-like spreadsheet interface. Supports 9 diagram types including flowcharts, sequence diagrams, state diagrams, class diagrams, ER diagrams, Gantt charts, pie charts, mind maps, and timelines.
